_comment: The competition roster. Add a player by adding an entry; nothing else needs editing.
round1 is their FINAL round-one score (11-17 Sep), from the official board.
A player who did not take part in round one gets round1: null. Give them
impute_round1: true and they carry the FIELD AVERAGE of everyone who did play it,
computed at load time so it can never drift. Owen's ruling, 21 Sep: a new player
scored on the week alone would win the championship off one week, which is not fair;
treating them as an average round-one performer is the defensible rule. The board
states it in plain language next to their name.
Leave impute_round1 off and they are scored on the week alone, marked as such.
detail is [fixed 20%, daily 80%, bias] exactly as the official board published it.
